# Durgesh Chavda — Chartered Accountant & Virtual CFO

> CA Durgesh Chavda is a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) and Virtual CFO based in Ahmedabad, India, with offices in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Rajkot and Dubai. He advises VC-backed startups, fund managers, family offices, NRIs and foreign companies on fundraising and investor reporting, fractional/virtual CFO work, US company incorporation from India, GIFT City (IFSC) fund and entity setup, SEBI AIF and venture capital fund setup, company setup in India for foreign companies (subsidiaries and GCCs), NRI taxation, FEMA/RBI compliance (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, ODI), GST and direct tax, valuation, AI-enabled finance and cross-border structuring (US Delaware, Singapore, DIFC, Mauritius). Clients are served remotely across India, the UAE and Gulf, the US, Canada, the UK and Europe, Singapore and Australia. He led and closed a USD 3.75M Pre-Series A for AI EdTech company Stimuler, and is Managing Partner at Finvy.

Contact: hello@durgeshchavda.com · WhatsApp/phone +91 78018 87130 · LinkedIn https://linkedin.com/in/ca-durgesh-chavda-bb08a6b0
